import MilneLib.Sheaf.TildeFinitePresentation
import MilneLib.Sheaf.TildeLocallyFree
import MilneLib.Sheaf.TildePullback
import MilneLib.Sheaf.SemilinearFiniteProjective

/-!
# Associated sheaves of affine invariant modules

The affine invariant module produced by finite Galois descent can be fed into
the native `tilde` construction. Its pullback recovers the original associated
sheaf, and finite projectivity gives free sheaves on basic-open neighborhoods.
These are affine sheaf inputs to Milne III.1.13; atlas gluing is separate.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry
open scoped TensorProduct

namespace MilneLib.GaloisDescent.SemilinearAction

variable (K L R : Type u) [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
  [CommRing R] [Algebra K R] [Algebra L R] [IsScalarTower K L R]
  [MulSemiringAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) R] [IsSemilinear K L R]
  [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
variable (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [Module L M]
  [Module R M] [IsScalarTower K L M] [IsScalarTower L R M]
  [IsScalarTower K R M] [DistribMulAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) M]
  [SMulDistribClass (L ≃ₐ[K] L) R M]

/-- The invariant module of a finitely presented semilinear module is realized
as a native finitely presented sheaf on the quotient affine spectrum. -/
theorem invariantModule_tilde_isFinitePresentation
    [Module.FinitePresentation R M] :
    let S : CommRingCat := CommRingCat.of (FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L))
    (AlgebraicGeometry.tilde (ModuleCat.of S (invariantModule K L R M))).IsFinitePresentation := by
  dsimp
  let S := FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation S (invariantModule K L R M) :=
    finitePresentation_invariantModule K L R M
  exact MilneLib.tilde_isFinitePresentation_of_module (R := CommRingCat.of S)
    (ModuleCat.of S (invariantModule K L R M))

/-- Pulling the associated invariant sheaf back to the original affine
spectrum recovers the associated sheaf of the semilinear module. -/
noncomputable def invariantModuleTildePullbackIso :
    let S : CommRingCat := CommRingCat.of (FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L))
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap S R)))).obj
        (tilde (ModuleCat.of S (invariantModule K L R M))) ≅
      tilde (R := CommRingCat.of R) (ModuleCat.of R M) := by
  dsimp
  let S : CommRingCat := CommRingCat.of (FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L))
  exact MilneLib.pullbackSpecTildeTensorIso (S := CommRingCat.of R)
      (ModuleCat.of S (invariantModule K L R M)) ≪≫
    (tilde.functor (CommRingCat.of R)).mapIso (moduleDescentEquiv K L R M).toModuleIso

/-- A finite projective semilinear module gives an invariant sheaf which
is finite free on a basic open neighborhood of each prime of the fixed algebra. -/
theorem exists_free_restriction_invariantModule_tilde
    [Module.Finite R M] [Module.Projective R M]
    (p : PrimeSpectrum (FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L))) :
    let S : CommRingCat := CommRingCat.of (FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L))
    ∃ f : S, f ∉ p.asIdeal ∧ ∃ ι : Type u, Finite ι ∧
      Nonempty ((tilde (ModuleCat.of S (invariantModule K L R M))).restrict
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap S (Localization.Away f)))) ≅
          SheafOfModules.free.{u} ι) := by
  classical
  dsimp
  let S : CommRingCat := CommRingCat.of (FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L))
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfree⟩ := exists_free_away_invariantModule K L R M p
  letI := hfree
  letI : Module.Finite S (invariantModule K L R M) := finite_invariantModule K L R M
  let T : CommRingCat := CommRingCat.of (Localization.Away f)
  let N : ModuleCat T := ModuleCat.of T (T ⊗[S] invariantModule K L R M)
  let b := Module.Free.chooseBasis T N
  exact ⟨f, hf, _, inferInstance, ⟨MilneLib.restrictSpecTildeTensorIso (S := T)
    (ModuleCat.of S (invariantModule K L R M)) ≪≫ MilneLib.tildeIsoFreeOfBasis N b⟩⟩

end MilneLib.GaloisDescent.SemilinearAction
